messages.subject: Alternate version installation not working.
parts:
I am running Rstudio  in Windows 7. I am cutting and pasting your installation command directly from the github help page, and I get: 


install.packages("http://win-builder.r-project.org/Z1N0He79FT3r/rstan_2.10.1-1.zip",
+                  repos = NULL, dependencies = TRUE) 
trying URL 'http://win-builder.r-project.org/Z1N0He79FT3r/rstan_2.10.1-1.zip'
Warning in install.packages :
  cannot open URL 'http://win-builder.r-project.org/Z1N0He79FT3r/rstan_2.10.1-1.zip': HTTP status was '404 Not Found'
Error in download.file(p, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) : 
  cannot open URL 'http://win-builder.r-project.org/Z1N0He79FT3r/rstan_2.10.1-1.zip'

I am trying this because I get the error on my recently installed rstan:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! g++.exe: error: Files/R/R-3.2.3/library/StanHeaders/libs/x64: No such file or directory

.

Is there any plan to really fix the error in the CRAN version?
